mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_saga_instances ( order_id, current_step, status, payload ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{currentStep}, #{status}, #{payload, typeHandler=com.gsvn.orderservice.handler.SagaPayloadTypeHandler}::jsonb )
mapper.update: UPDATE order_saga_instances SET current_step = #{currentStep}, status = #{status}, payload = #{payload, typeHandler=com.gsvn.orderservice.handler.SagaPayloadTypeHandler}::jsonb, updated_at = NOW() WHERE saga_id = #{sagaId}
UPDATE order_saga_instances SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE saga_id = #{sagaId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM order_saga_instances WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
